position.card: Card liability: {liability}. Card repayments of {repayments} debit the card liability and credit bank; the purchase was recorded separately, so repayment is not another expense.
position.spending: Purchases total {total}: business-classified spending {business}, personal {personal}, mixed {mixed}. Recognized business expenses are {recognized}; another {review} of business purchases needs expense-versus-asset review. Card repayments are excluded. Business classification does not establish tax deductibility.
position.incomeTypes: Received by category: {categories}. Advances of {advances} remain a liability; employment wages of {wages} are separate from business income. Licence receipts retain their licence/IP facts and require tax classification review.

position.tax: Final tax cannot yet be reliably determined. Blockers: {blockers}. No zero tax, withholding rate or treaty benefit is assumed.
position.profit: Recorded business income {income}, recognized business expenses {expenses}, provisional recorded net {net}. Final business profit is not reliable while mixed purchases of {mixed} and business asset/expense review of {review} remain unresolved. Advances and personal wages are separate.
position.bank: Recorded bank balance: {amount}. This includes opening funds and is different from cash received during the recorded period.
position.hotel: Hotel remains mixed-purpose pending allocation review. Your recorded reason: {reason}. No business percentage, full business expense or tax deduction was invented.
position.policy: There are {count} accounting/tax review items: mixed-use allocation, licence/IP treatment, advances and expense-versus-asset policy. Confirmed purchases and payments remain recorded; uncertain treatment is not silently approved.
position.treaties: Potential research contexts: {contexts}. Treaty applicability is not established by citizenship, home or payer alone. Missing approved coverage remains review-required.
position.confirmed: The recorded data contains {engagements} income engagements and balanced journals: {balanced}. Human-confirmed records are distinct from unapproved law, unknown withholding and unallocated costs.

scope.answer.salary: Employment receipts {salary} from {employer}; physical work location {work}. Wages are separate from venture revenue. Withholding documentation requires review; zero withholding is not assumed.
scope.answer.cafe: Operating revenue {cafeRevenue}, recognized expenses {cafeExpenses}, recorded operating result {cafeNet}. This is not final taxable profit; salary and gym funding are excluded.
scope.answer.villa: Recognized rental revenue {villaRevenue}; original receipts {villaReceipts}; guest advances {villaAdvances} remain liabilities; contractual outstanding {villaOwed}. Mixed personal/rental use needs reviewed allocation, never an invented percentage.
scope.answer.gym: Owner funding {gymCapital}, not revenue. Recorded purchases/payments {gymPurchases}. The project is pre-opening; its funding is separate from operating/rental revenue.
scope.answer.assets: Gym payments awaiting asset/expense policy review {gymReview}; refundable deposit assets {gymDeposits}; recognized expenses {gymExpenses}. Equipment was not automatically expensed. Policy and tax remain review-required.
scope.answer.personal: Personal purchases {personal}. Mixed-use purchases across activities {mixed} require review, not automatic business/personal allocation. Card repayments {repayments} settle debt and are not additional expenses.
scope.answer.expenses: Purchases by activity: {expenses}. Payments are not all recognized expenses or tax deductions. Assets, deposits and mixed costs remain distinct.
scope.answer.card: Shared card liability {liability}; repayments {repayments} reduced liability and bank without another expense. Purchases retain activity tags; shared cardholder debt is not presented as separate legal entity books.
scope.answer.currencies: Original recorded currencies: {currencies}. Shared bookkeeping is in IDR; original salary and purchase currencies remain available. Language changes never change currency; no new exposure valuation was invented.
scope.answer.countries: Citizenship {nationality}, home connection {home}, current physical presence {physical}, employment work {work}, employer context {employerCountry}, business/asset locations {businessCountries}. These roles do not establish tax residence or income source.
scope.answer.residence: Indonesian tax residence cannot be determined. From {start} until before {end}, recorded Indonesian presence is {days} days. Intervals: {intervals}. Entry-inclusive/exit-exclusive calendar counting is not a legal residence test. Governed rules and facts need review.
scope.answer.tax: Final tax is unknown, not zero. Approved coverage for {countries}, residence, source and withholding need review. No fake global profit combines salary, owner funding and ventures.
scope.answer.blockers: Final tax is blocked by incomplete approved coverage for {countries}, unconfirmed residence/source, withholding documents, mixed villa allocation, gym asset policy, payroll treatment and treaty applicability. Research contexts are not confirmed treaties or entitlements.
scope.answer.confirmed: Profile {confirmed}; {count} balanced journals. Salary, venture income, investment funding and personal activity preserve separate scopes, dates and original currencies. Human fact confirmation does not approve law or tax.
scope.answer.summary: One person has employment, personal life, rental, operating business and an investment project, each shown separately. Shared recorded cash/bank {cash}; shared card debt {liability}. No single final global profit is asserted. Investments, advances and salary are not venture sales; tax and unresolved policies need review.
